follow_ups_help: Schedule and track calls with customers and leads. Link each reminder to a client for full CRM history.
no_reminders_help: Schedule your first call reminder. You can link it to a customer from the Customers page.
hr_help: Manage your team: add employees, run monthly payroll (11% social insurance), approve leaves, record attendance.
no_employees_help: Add your sales agents, accountants, and HR staff to run payroll.
no_payroll_help: Click Generate Monthly Payroll to calculate salaries with Egyptian social insurance deductions.
payroll_error: Payroll may already exist for this month
no_leaves_help: Employees can request annual or sick leave. Approve pending requests here.
no_attendance_help: Record daily check-in and check-out for your team.
finance_help: Track sales, collections, and cash. Use quick links to collect payments or view contracts.
full_reports_desc: Export all financial reports to Excel
no_accounts_help: Chart of accounts is created automatically for new companies.
no_journal_help: Journal entries are created when you record contract payments. Create a contract first.
call_queue_help: Work through today's calls: dial, log outcomes, and auto-schedule the next follow-up.
select_call_to_work: Select a call from the list to see details and log the outcome.
call_notes_placeholder: What did the client say? Budget, unit preference, objections…
bulk_import_help: Upload a CSV or Excel file from any CRM or spreadsheet. The system auto-detects column names in English or Arabic and maps them to customer fields.
upload_customer_file: Drop or choose your customer file
supported_formats: CSV, XLSX — any column layout from any company
column_mapping_help: We auto-detected your columns. Adjust any mapping below, then click Apply Mapping.
create_leads_on_import: Also create CRM leads for new customers
manage_modules_help: Choose which modules {{company}} can see and use. Unchecked features disappear from their sidebar and are blocked on the API.
subscriptions_help: Create and edit plans with monthly or yearly pricing, descriptions, limits, and features. Download PDF brochures for customers.
platform_settings_help: Configure global platform options. Changes apply to all tenants.
database_backup_help: Create a PostgreSQL dump on the server. Run during low-traffic periods.
password_min_length: Password must be at least 6 characters
password_min_8: Password must be at least 8 characters
users_admin_help: Edit user details, reset passwords, or suspend accounts. Super admin accounts cannot be modified here.
companies_billing_help: Manage company subscriptions, payment terms, due dates, and send payment reminders.
trial_help: The company gets full access for 14 days. After that, login is blocked until payment is recorded.
trial_days_left: {{count}} day(s) left in your free trial
trial_ends_today: Your free trial ends today — contact support to subscribe
trial_expired_login: Your 14-day free trial has ended. Contact support@fratelanza.com to subscribe and restore access.
confirm_delete: Are you sure you want to delete this record?
contract_pdf_help: Download a print-ready bilingual PDF with buyer details, unit information, and the full payment plan. Use Mark Signed after e-signature approval.
collections_help: Installments linked to contracts — record payments to update balances.
installment_calculator_help: Enter unit price and down payment, choose frequency (monthly, quarterly, annual), then generate a schedule. Edit any installment amount — remaining installments rebalance automatically.
installment_manual_hint: Manually edited rows are fixed; the remaining balance is spread equally across other installments.
units_board_help: Click an available unit to create a reservation.
name: Name
no_data_help: No records yet. Use the Add button above or click below to create your first entry.
demo_data_loaded: Demo data loaded. Refresh the page if tables are still empty.
login_username_help: Sign in with your username (not email). Demo: demo_admin
projects_help: Manage projects, units board, and inventory in one place.
property_help: Track maintenance requests linked to units and customers.
customer_service_help: Manage support tickets from customers and leads.
no_payslips_help: Generate monthly payroll to create payslips for all employees.
customers_help: Full CRM for buyers and owners — profile, contracts, reservations, calls, and activity history.
select_customer_profile: Select a customer from the list to view their full profile.
no_customer_contracts: No contracts yet — create from Reservations.
no_customer_reservations: No reservations yet — book from Projects → Units Board.
add_customer_note_placeholder: Add a note about this customer…
property_about: After handover: track unit defects and repairs for owners and tenants.
property_step_unit: Owner reports an issue on a sold/delivered unit (AC, plumbing, doors…).
property_step_customer: Link the request to the unit and the customer who owns it.
property_step_fix: Track priority and status until the maintenance team completes the job.
property_example: Example: Unit A1-02 — "AC not cooling" → assign to maintenance → mark completed when fixed.
warehouse_about: Warehouses are storage locations. Inventory is the stock (materials) inside them.
warehouse_explainer_body: Open the Inventory tab to see all stock items (cement, steel, tiles…). Each item shows which warehouse it is stored in and the current quantity.
warehouse_locations_help: Physical storage sites — site store, main depot, project store.
inventory_help: All materials and stock quantities across your warehouses.
inventory_overview_help: Quick snapshot of stock levels — switch to Inventory tab for the full list.
feature_settings_help: View which platform features your company has access to. Per-user access is managed from the Users page.
company_features_contact_superadmin: Only the platform super admin can add or remove features for your company. Contact support if you need changes.
per_user_features_hint: To control what each team member sees, go to Users and click the features icon next to their name.
user_features_help: Choose which features {{user}} can see. They cannot access features your company does not have.
user_inherits_company_modules: This user currently sees all company-enabled features.
unlimited_hint: Enter 0 for unlimited users, projects, or storage.
pricing_engine_help: Automatically increase list prices for available units when sales volume or construction progress crosses your thresholds. Signed contracts keep their agreed price.
pricing_total_adjustment_help: Applied to all available units: new price = base price × (1 + uplift%). Capped at 50% combined.
pricing_no_rules_help: Add tier rules below. When sales or construction crosses a threshold, the matching uplift applies.
pricing_add_rule_help: Each rule adds an uplift when the metric reaches the threshold. The highest matching tier per trigger type applies; sales and construction uplifts stack.
pricing_select_project_help: Add a project first to configure dynamic pricing rules.
master_plan_help: Interactive floor grid and site map. Unit colors reflect live status — click a unit for details.
master_plan_select_project_help: Choose a project to view its master plan.
master_plan_no_units_help: Add buildings, floors, and units to populate the master plan.
ai_reporting_subtitle: Analyze sales tables and generate quick performance summaries powered by OpenAI or Gemini.
ai_assistant_subtitle: Ask about sales, collections, leads, and trends — answers use your live company data.
ai_assistant_empty: Ask about sales performance, collections risk, or market trends. Try «What are our total sales?» or click Performance summary.
ai_input_placeholder: Ask about sales, collections, or leads…

portal_next_installments_help: Next payments due on your contracts.
